title: 128 spaces
text: The longest token is 128 spaces in a row. Code is full of indentation, so the model learned a single piece for it.
The longest word-like token comes from iPhone app code. The model has read that much programming.
The whole alphabet, in order, is just one token. So is the uppercase version.
·return, a coding word, got number 471. ·pizza is all the way at 23,317. Lower numbers usually mean the piece showed up more often in training.
·Minecraft, ·Bitcoin, and ·Hogwarts each got their own entry. But “TikTok” and “ChatGPT” didn’t, so they get built from smaller pieces.
Entry number zero is just an exclamation point. Every number from 0 to 999 also has its own entry.
